title: Common law rights
bodyText: . Nothing in this chapter shall adversely affect common law rights in trade names, entity names, service marks, or trademarks, or the enforcement of those rights.
bodyHtml: [§482-53]  Common law rights.  Nothing in this chapter shall adversely affect common law rights in trade names, entity names, service marks, or trademarks, or the enforcement of those rights. [L 2008, c 108, pt of §1]
